name: VidKing Integration
description: Dynamic remote stream resolution for VidKing sources. Optional Playwright-based extraction of real MP4 URLs from 1Embed.cc for native Jellyfin playback.
overview: Resolves .vking files (TMDb/IMDb ID pointers) into Jellyfin media items. Tier 1: optional real MP4 extraction via headless Chromium. Tier 2: stream proxy endpoint for web clients. Tier 3: iframe fallback.
